verdict.rationale: Replit's marketing copy vaguely claims 'Screening and secure services keep apps safe' alongside SOC 2/SSO controls, but there is no documented feature describing an automated pre-publish security review of generated app code (e.g., vulnerability scanning, code audit report) in the docs. Community evidence even shows agent-generated apps suffering severe issues (fake data, production DB deletion) without any described security-review gate catching them. Missing for 10: a concrete documented security-scan/report step tied to publishing, independent verification that such screening catches real vulnerabilities, and evidence it runs specifically on generated code before going live.
